verdict.rationale: Okta is an identity and admin platform where automations such as workflows and event hooks are plausible, so this axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. The only related items are event hooks, the MCP server for admin operations, and a generic 'manage and automate Okta' line, none of which describe version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
